title: THE LIE THAT KEEPS PEOPLE BUSY

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: ""They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.' Make the work harder for the people so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies."" - Exodus 5:8b-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Pharaoh names his strategy openly: make the work harder so that they keep working and pay no attention.

He is not trying to make them believe something false. He is simply trying to make them too tired to listen. If they are exhausted enough, God's word will not get through.

That strategy has never gone out of use. Many believers today are not fighting doubt; they are fighting exhaustion. There is no time to open the Bible, no energy left for prayer, no capacity to think about eternity. Not because they have rejected God's word, but because life is loud and full and heavy.

Jesus warned about the seed that fell among thorns — choked by the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth (Mt 13:22). The thorns do not attack the seed. They simply crowd it out.

Notice what Pharaoh calls God's promise: lies. Truth is always inconvenient to those profiting from the current arrangement.

Guard your time with God fiercely. Something is always trying to crowd it out.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I too busy to hear God, and who or what has made me that busy?
2. What one thing could I remove this week to make room for God's word?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, do not let busyness drown out Your voice. Help me to make room for You even in a demanding season. Amen.
